topography.project_purpose: Seer is a decentralized prediction market protocol that allows users to create and trade outcome tokens on future events. It uses conditional token frameworks and automated market makers to facilitate trading and liquidity provision.
topography.relationship_narrative: MarketFactory deploys individual Market contracts that interact with ConditionalTokens for outcome token minting and redemption. AlgebraFactory and FutarchyFactory provide AMM infrastructure, while MarketView offers read-only aggregation, all sharing the same conditional token framework.
